A power plant in the heart of Mahanagar has been infested by the Arachnids. It would take a lot of manpower and materiel to root them out.

By disabling the network of power transformers, however, the plant's core is expected to overheat and explode - thus breaking the Bugs' foothold in the district.
Hold out until the Power Core explodes

column2: The Mobile Infantry has just disabled the first power transformer.
Another power transformer has been shut down. We’re already halfway there!
One more power transformer remains in the district. Keep it up, Troopers!
The Arachnids have infested one of Mahanagar’s power stations, turning it into a formidable stronghold.
A direct assault on the facility would take considerable time, resources and the lives of many brave troopers.
Instead, an ingenious plan has been concocted: By disabling the surrounding power transformers, the power core will overload. The resulting shockwave is expected to wipe out the entire Bug nest.
Some of the M.I.’s best and most advanced assets have been assigned to this operation. Success is guaranteed!

column2: Human ingenuity prevails over Bug brutality once more. One power station is a cheap price to pay for the liberty and safety of our citizens!
